definition: Aman Sanger is an American entrepreneur and software executive.
details: Co-built Cursor's custom fast-apply and next-edit prediction models for AI-assisted software engineering. He is a co-founder of Anysphere, the company behind Cursor, an artificial intelligence-assisted code editor. He co-founded the company in 2022 with Michael Truell, Sualeh Asif and Arvid Lunnemark, whom he met while studying at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

explainer.lead: Aman Sanger is an American entrepreneur.

contributions.name: He was a co-author of a 2021 paper published in Nature Methods on Tangram, a deep-learning framework for spatially resolved single-cell transcriptomics.

timeline.what: He attended the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), where he studied computer science and mathematics from 2018 to 2022.
